## Competing Interests

O.E. is a co-founder of and stockholder in Volastra Therapeutics; holds stock in Freenome; serves on the Scientific Advisory Boards of and holds stock options in Owkin, Harmonic Discovery and Exai; and serves on the Scientific Advisory Board of Canary Biosciences. He has received research funding from Eli Lilly, Janssen/Johnson & Johnson, Sanofi, AstraZeneca and Volastra Therapeutics.
